title: Training Designer: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Fitters need the leak-test hold point; the missing checklist is a system fix, not a training need.

items.title: Return to service
items.objective: Carry out and record a leak test before restart
content: Competence standard: to be set by the competence system owner
Refresher interval: to be set by the competence system owner

items.situation: The pump is back from a seal change and the test rig is unavailable.
prompts: Facilitator: listen for a refusal to restart

items.question: At which HFACS level is the missing checklist?
items.why: Tests whether the cause is placed at the level that owns the fix.

items.question: Which fix addresses the missing checklist at the level that owns it?
items.why: Checks that the learner reaches for a system fix, not retraining.
items.answer: The hold point in the permit, because it changes the system.

options.text: Make the leak-test hold point part of the permit
Remind the fitter to be more careful

items.question: A missing checklist is best explained by one fitter's lapse.
items.why: Checks that the learner looks for the condition behind the act.
items.answer: False: look for the condition that made the omission likely.

rows: % of restarts with a test record
